events.description: Ross Geller says Phoebe Buffay owes $7.50.
Ross Geller says Monica Geller owes $10.
Ross Geller says Rachel Green owes $15.
Joey Tribbiani says Monica Geller, Rachel Green, and Phoebe Buffay taught the group Cross-Eyed Mary.
Joey Tribbiani says Joey Tribbiani, Chandler Bing, and Ross Geller plan to play Cross-Eyed Mary at their regular game.
Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe Buffay is giving $7.50.
Phoebe Buffay says Joey Tribbiani should know that Phoebe Buffay’s $7.50 is cursed.
Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe Buffay has cursed the $7.50 she gave.
Phoebe Buffay says bad things will happen to anyone who spends Phoebe Buffay’s cursed $7.50.
Chandler Bing says Phoebe Buffay’s cursing of the money is alright.
Chandler Bing says Chandler Bing will take Phoebe Buffay’s cursed $7.50.
Chandler Bing says bad things happen to Chandler Bing anyway.
Chandler Bing says Chandler Bing can break up the bad things by watching a movie.
Ross Geller says only Rachel Green, the “big Green poker machine,” is left to settle her debt.
Ross Geller says Rachel Green owes $15.
Rachel Green says Ross Geller is a man.
Rachel Green says Ross Geller has a penis.
Rachel Green says Ross Geller has to win money to exert his power over women.
Rachel Green says Ross Geller exerts his power over women.
Monica Geller says Ross Geller, Chandler Bing, and Joey Tribbiani know what Monica Geller means.
Monica Geller says the poker contest is not over.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller, Rachel Green, and Phoebe Buffay will play Ross Geller and Chandler Bing again.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller, Rachel Green, and Phoebe Buffay will win the rematch.
Monica Geller says Ross Geller and Chandler Bing will lose the rematch.
Monica Geller says Ross Geller and Chandler Bing will beg.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller, Rachel Green, and Phoebe Buffay will laugh at Ross Geller and Chandler Bing.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller, Rachel Green, and Phoebe Buffay will take every last dime Ross Geller and Chandler Bing have.
Monica Geller says Ross Geller and Chandler Bing will hate themselves forever.
Rachel Green says Monica Geller just stepped on Rachel Green’s point.
